id: title:bernatixer:skip summarization exception capture when temporal will retry

observations.behavior: Adds a README note and a README-only hunk.
observations.code_quote: - A failed LLM call is captured as an exception only on the last attempt of `summarize_and_save_activity`. An earlier attempt logs `OpenAI API call failed, retry pending` at warning level, because the retry can still save the summary.
observations.posthog_connection: Documentation of the failure-handling and exception-capture behavior for the trace summarization workflow.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional argument to the activity, using the Temporal attempt count to distinguish the final attempt.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the activity to distinguish whether it is the last scheduled attempt, supporting conditional exception raising.

observations.behavior: Adds imports and a helper to run the activity in a test environment, and parameterizes the attempt argument.
